R1 every transcription unmeasured: present with a null grade, undetermined, the empty level named, the capture counted
R1 several captures: one measured transcription determines the ceiling; the strongest capture bounds the document
R1 over-strictness: publisher-typed text and a capture never read earn the byte ceiling, gaining no key from the bound
R1 the census's equivalence: extraction's published `transcribed` and `derivation_cap` recompute the registry's letter for every document
R2 legCapped reads a leg against the fidelity-bound entry: capped to C with its why, and undetermined with the reason
R3 earnedBasis: an inquiry's legs on the corpus read the bound entries it answers, and a hidden viewer reads nothing
R3 which capture each leg rests on: pinned by its bytes (extent_capture or content_id), only_capture, or undetermined naming the count held and the row's capture, never back-filled
R1 R3 earnedBasis at content grain: a portion's connection axis is undetermined with the empty level named (NO_CONNECTION), never borrowed; a document row earns its document's
R1 R3 earnedBasis for a cell leg: names the leg's row; its standing is about THIS extent, its connection and transcription undetermined and stated, its ref the cell
R3 the backfill: a leg promoted before its document was captured gets exactly the hashed document row on the first read, and is found, not re-minted, on the next
R3 the backfill's bound bites at LEG_BACKFILL_MAX over 51 legs, says so, names the rest NOT_YET_RESOLVED needing no cursor, and the next read continues onto one row
R3 the two legitimate nulls are stated as which, each with its own sentence, never collapsed
R1 a whole-document attestation of a chainless capture does not raise a member's typing through a leg; a second member's attestation of the typing does
R4 basisFor answers the projected legs in order; restingOn every leg naming the target, confirmed or severed by the citer's record
R17 restingOn and restsOnLive read each leg's own status: one severed passage of a document leaves the other live
R4 basisFor with a limit reads at most that many legs in SQL, the first by ord, and says it was cut
R5 restsOnLive: a divided citer skipped, a severed one severed, a case member's frozen, the rest confirmed
R5 a case-membership fact no module answers counts the citer as a case member: frozen, never confirmed
R6 cyclePath answers the whole cycle path [id, target, …, id] for the first target that would close one through inquiry legs, else null
R6 the walk terminates over a shared sub-basis (each inquiry visited once) and over an imported finding reference
R6 the walk terminates over a shared sub-basis (each inquiry visited once) and over an imported finding reference > <name not written out, line 108>
R7 the projects drawing on a question are read at most 32, the first by id, with truncated; a severed citer takes no slot and the bound never decides
R3 earnedBasis lists a leg on an imported finding reference as the question's own, earning nothing, its null case IMPORTED_TARGET
R3 R4 the routes plane takes after inquiry's job: basis, restson and earnedbasis answer as the reads do, the viewer from the stamp
R13 projectsDrawingOnPaged answers every project drawing on the question, a page at a time by id with cursor; severed citers and non-projects take no slot
R13 the limit is at most 500, default 100; R7's 32-bound stays for its callers while the pages answer every project

R14 projectsShownOn answers the non-hidden projects drawing on a question, each {id, name} as the viewer's sight lets her see it; a hidden project is never answered, named or counted, even to its participants
R14 R11 a viewer who may not see the question is answered exactly as for an absent one; no id is NO_ID
R14 at most 200 shown, the first by id, truncated only when one more would be shown: hidden projects past the bound never set it

R15 at an extent a member attested against the page the passage earns the capture's own grade; elsewhere it stays undetermined
R15 an attested AI passage of an uploaded capture earns its letter stated as authored; an unruled route stays undetermined
R15 negative controls: a passage no AI step covers keeps content's document pointer, and an answer asked with no content ids is unchanged
